name: pk-cli-connector
description: Deploy-your-own Cloudflare Worker that serves piekstra-family CLI tools to Claude (web, desktop, mobile) as a custom MCP connector.

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: A long random passphrase, 20 characters or more (for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 24`). You type it on this connector's approval page when you connect Claude; nobody without it can connect. Keep it in your password manager.

CBASE_API_KEY_NAME.description: Coinbase (optional; leave `none` to skip): your CDP API key's name, `organizations/…/apiKeys/…`, from the key file Coinbase gives you. Create the key at https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/projects/api-keys with the View permission only.

CBASE_API_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Coinbase (optional; leave `none` to skip): that key's private key, the `privateKey` value from the key file, the whole PEM including the BEGIN and END lines. Pasting it on one line is fine.

ALP_API_KEY_ID.description: Alpaca (optional; leave `none` to skip): an API Key ID from your Alpaca dashboard (https://app.alpaca.markets, API Keys). The connector only reads; for paper-trading keys, add a variable ALP_ENV=paper after deploying.

ALP_API_SECRET_KEY.description: Alpaca (optional; leave `none` to skip): the Secret Key shown with that Key ID (Alpaca shows it once).

OAUTH_KV.description: Where the connector keeps OAuth clients, grants and hashed tokens. A new namespace is right.
